subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or rebase the open fork PR for the Debug Snapshots fix, or close that path and allow a fresh narrow fix from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open conflicting fork PR already references this issue with closing syntax, so automation should not create duplicate repair work until maintainers choose the PR path.

options.title: Supersede the fork and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against the current Debug page structure.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch and repair it against the current Debug page/view split before review.

recommendation.title: Supersede the fork and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the conflicting fork PR, then let a new narrow Control UI fix address this issue against the current Debug page structure.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the Debug page wiring and the recent split that now owns the affected files.
